observation_summary: The compiler failed to emit warnings for type mismatches involving constructors and enums because the logic in TypeValidator explicitly bypassed the mismatch reporting for these types.
reasoning_summary: The fix involved removing conditional blocks that were suppressing type mismatch warnings for constructors and enums. This is a correction of the procedural logic (the algorithm) used to determine when to report a type mismatch, rather than a missing guard (Checking) or a simple value assignment. The logic was incorrectly filtering out valid mismatch cases.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows the removal of 'if ((leftType.isConstructor() || leftType.isEnumType()) && (rightType.isConstructor() || rightType.isEnumType()))' blocks in TypeValidator.
The bug report indicates that the compiler should have emitted warnings for these cases but did not.
The failing tests confirm that the compiler was missing expected warnings.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves removing an 'if' condition, the condition was not a guard for a null or bounds check, but rather an incorrect filtering logic that prevented the intended algorithmic behavior (reporting mismatches) from executing.
